defs.def: to prevent sth bad from happening 避免；防止

ex.s: If only the effort they put into avoiding responsibility could be redirected into, well, actual responsibility.
ex.t: 要是他们用来逃避责任的那份力气能转移到——嗯——真正的责任上就好了。

ex.s: We need the ability to work out which messes are worth avoiding — because however impressively fast you move, some things can’t be easily unbroken.
ex.t: 我们需要具备分辨哪些混乱值得避免的能力——因为无论你行动得多快，有些东西一旦打破就很难复原。

ex.s: Inside the office, they encourage recycling and waste reduction by limiting garbage cans and avoiding single-use plastic.
ex.t: 在办公室里，他们通过减少垃圾桶、避免使用一次性塑料来鼓励回收利用和减少浪费。

ex.s: Can overtourism be avoided then?
ex.t: 那么过度旅游可以避免吗？

ex.s: Humans are skilled at avoiding dangers.
ex.t: 她尊重他人的隐私。

ex.s: You’ll hear these participants’ stories and learn what strategies worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.
ex.t: 你将听到这些参与者的故事，了解哪些策略对他们有效，以及他们遇到了哪些你应当避免的陷阱。

ex.s: So, it’s been useful to know how to cover up holes and repaint a room to avoid any charges when I’ve moved out.”
ex.t: 所以，懂得如何遮盖墙洞并重新粉刷房间，以便搬家时避免任何扣费，一直很有用。

ex.s: How did Terri avoid losing the deposit on the house she rented?
ex.t: Terri是怎么避免她租房子的押金丢失的?

ex.s: I often leave early to seek the right destinations so I can set up early to avoid missing the moment I am attempting to photograph.
ex.t: 我经常早早出发去寻找合适的目的地，这样我可以提前架好设备，避免错过我想拍摄的瞬间。

ex.s: And by understanding how we slipped, we can avoid falling in the future.
ex.t: 通过理解我们是如何滑倒的，我们可以在未来避免摔倒。

ex.s: B Avoid making mistakes and be a perfectionist.
ex.t: B 避免犯错，做一个完美主义者。

ex.s: The way you handle chopsticks is important to avoid annoying your companions.
ex.t: 你使用筷子的方式很重要，避免惹恼同伴。

ex.s: That can be dangerous work that could be avoided with drones assisting the crews’ efforts.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁轨或道岔造成安全问题之前检测故障。

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury figures.
ex.t: （翻译待校对补充）

ex.s: Avoiding giving unwise suggestions.
ex.t: 避免给出不明智的建议。

ex.s: Recently a leading scientist said the scientific method was to avoid fooling oneself into thinking something is true that is not.
ex.t: 最近，一位顶尖科学家说，科学方法就是避免自欺欺人地相信不真实的东西。

ex.s: avoid making the same mistakes
ex.t: 避免犯同样的错误

ex.s: He avoided taking on new challenges.
ex.t: 他成为了一名成功的喜剧演员。

ex.s: avoid responsibilities at work
ex.t: 避免工作中的责任

ex.s: And contrary to existing research that says you should avoid eating with heavier people who order large portions（份）, it’s the beanpoles with big appetites you really need to avoid.
ex.t: 与现有研究说你应该避免和点大份量的胖人一起吃饭相反真正需要避免的是那些胃口很大的瘦子。

ex.s: To avoid getting stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途风景。

ex.s: A disaster was avoided.
ex.t: 一场灾难得以避免。

ex.s: Failure should be avoided.
ex.t: 成功来自共同努力。

ex.s: Why do the leaves and branches of different trees avoid touching each other?
ex.t: 为什么不同树木的枝叶会避免相互接触？

ex.t: 作者在他的工作中避免做什么？

ex.s: avoid disturbing the president's work
ex.t: 以合适的角度观察总统

ex.s: It encourages us to occupy our own little corner, to avoid foolish leaps into the dark, to be satisfied.
ex.t: 而大众追求安稳和平庸。

ex.s: I quickly lower myself, ducking my head to avoid    64    (look) directly into his eyes so he doesn’t feel    65   (challenge).
ex.t: 我迅速蹲下身子，低下头避免____64____（look）直视它的眼睛，以免让它感到____65____（challenge）被挑衅。

ex.s: A． To avoid jumping to conclusions．
ex.t: A．为避免草率下结论。

ex.s: 21．（10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

ex.s: They take their driverless car to an appointment and set the empty vehicle to circle the building to avoid paying for parking.
ex.t: 他们开自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕楼转圈以逃避停车费。

ex.s: When you want to avoid interruptions at work
ex.t: 当你想避免工作中被打扰时

ex.s: Why should the students avoid mixing liquid with paper?
ex.t: 学生为什么应该避免把液体和纸混在一起？

ex.s: When you want to avoid interruptions at work
ex.t: 当你想避免工作中被打扰时

ex.s: After all, if we adapt in that way, we may avoid the need to change in so many others.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果我们以这种方式适应，也许就不需要在其他方面做出如此多的改变了。

ex.s: avoid robots’ affecting the world
ex.t: 现在我们有了最直接的证据证明他是正确的。

ex.s: Keep the room cool rather than warm to avoid feeling sleepy.
ex.t: 保持房间凉爽而不是温暖，以避免犯困。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.s: Jenny 31 Teacher (1 picture) My husband and I avoid all products that come from animals.
ex.t: 珍妮 31岁 教师（1张图片）我丈夫和我避免所有来自动物的产品。

ex.s: I’m just too busy and tired to cook at home!” _5 “If you’re someone who avoids animal products, you wouldn’t find anything to eat in my fridge!” 1 What do you think the saying “You are what you eat”means?

ex.s: Now that it’s hard to avoid a disaster on Earth, perhaps I should start thinking about moving to space… 5 “The next station is Bank!” comes the announcement.
ex.t: 既然在地球上很难避免灾难，也许我该开始考虑搬到太空去了…… 5 “下一站是Bank！”广播声传来。

defs.def: to keep away from sb/sth; to try not to do sth 回避；避开；躲避

ex.s: While many species’ thought processes are limited to “Food, eat it!”, “Danger, run!”, “Pain, avoid!”, we’ve evolved beyond that.
ex.t: 许多物种的思维仅限于“食物，吃掉！”“危险，快跑！”“疼痛，避开！”，而我们已进化得超越这些。

ex.s: Our brains use the system to acquire behavioural patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food gathering and dangers to avoid.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这一系统习得有关安全回家路线、高效觅食以及需要避开的危险的行为模式。

ex.s: How to avoid rush-hour traffic.
ex.t: 如何避开高峰时段的交通。

ex.s: avoided oil painting practiceB. sought for a painting career
ex.t: 回避油画练习　B. 寻求从事绘画生涯

ex.s: It is easier to avoid a discussion，but risking talking about it may eventually lead to a better outcome．
ex.t: 避开讨论更容易，但冒险谈出来最终可能会带来更好的结果。

ex.s: It ran for just under seven kilometers and allowed people to avoid terrible __61__ (crowd) on the roads above as they travelled to and ___62__ word.
ex.t: 它运行了不到七公里，让人们在上方的道路上前往和____62____（word）时避开可怕的____61__（crowd）人群。

ex.s: “But we all have to accept that as we get older our reactions slow down and this often results in people avoiding any potentially challenging driving conditions and losing confidence in their driving skills.
ex.t: “但我们都必须接受，随着年龄增长，我们的反应会变慢，这通常导致人们避开任何可能有挑战的驾驶状况，并对自己的驾驶技术失去信心。”

ex.s: In 1863the first underground passenger railway in the world opened in London. z&xxk It ran for just under seven kilometers and allowed people to avoid terrible __61__(crowd) on the roads above as they travelled to and ___62__ word.
ex.t: 1863年，世界上第一条地下客运铁路在伦敦开通。它运行了不到七公里，让人们在上方道路上前往和____62__（word）时避开可怕的__61__（crowd）人群。

ex.s: And my shyness has caused me to avoid attending events, not make important connections, and keep my ideas to myself.
ex.t: 我细小的声音让我感到非常害羞。

ex.s: It is also said that mice and snakes head for safer ground several days before an earthquake, while dogs avoiding the beach may be a sign that a tsunami is approaching.
ex.t: 还有人说，老鼠和蛇会在地震前几天逃往更安全的地方，而狗避开海滩可能是海啸即将来临的征兆。
